Board 1 covers croissants and blended/ice-cream drinks; board 2 covers donuts and hot/cold drinks. Skipped 'Glaze Include Fill' $0.40 (an upcharge, not a standalone item price) and 'Floats $.50' (ambiguous whether that is a full price or an add-on to a base item not shown). Ice Blended and Ice Cream Cone are recorded as single category rows since the board shows one price for the flavor list, not per-flavor prices — flavors listed in description, not invented as separate priced dishes.
